description.en: Let coding agents debate solutions while you review, compare, and decide.
description.zh: 让多个编程智能体提出方案、展开讨论，由你比较、审阅并做决定。

source.description: Local AI coding agent debate platform — agents push solutions, humans review

description.en: Two ivory faces share one broad walnut chess clock, with a brass plunger above each side. The paired mechanism gives agent debate and human checkpoints a tangible metaphor.
description.zh: 两面象牙色钟盘共用一座宽阔胡桃木棋钟，各配黄铜按钮，以双侧计时比喻 Agent 讨论与人工检查点。

description.en: Natural wood grain, opaque dial faces and crisp metal rims carry the detail. One complete compact object remains legible as the camera pulls back.
description.zh: 天然木纹、不透明钟盘和清晰金属包边构成细节；镜头拉远时仍是一件完整、紧凑、易识别的实物。

description.en: Two offset dial arcs with alternating short speaking-turn marks on warm oak-toned paper. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 暖色纸面上的双侧计时弧线与交错回合短刻度。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

palette.source: Adopted Arena presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the twin ivory dials and walnut frame remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认双象牙色钟盘与胡桃木边框；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Collect coding assistants’ proposals on a local discussion board, let a person record decisions, and return those checkpoints to assistants through a CLI.
goal.zh: 在本机讨论看板汇集编码助手的方案，由人记录决策，再通过 CLI 将 checkpoint 提供给助手读取。

description.en: Two offset dial arcs alternate with short speaking-turn marks, giving each side room to respond.
description.zh: 两道错开的表盘弧线与短短的轮次刻度交替出现，为对话双方各留一席。

alt.en: Walnut dual-dial chess clock on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 胡桃木双盘棋钟，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 让两种观点，推近一个好决定。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥72px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 72px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
